title: Severed-wire audit of src/thinker (prompt assembly, identity, memory-context, provider registry)

findings.title: MemoryContextConfig.max_facts and similarity_threshold are dead config fields (inert config, form 3)
findings.rationale: MemoryContextConfig declares three fields; only max_output_chars is ever read (memory.rs:77 derives the token budget from it). Grep across the tree finds zero reads of config.max_facts or config.similarity_threshold, and the single production construction site (handlers/memory.rs:392) calls MemoryContextConfig::default(), so both fields are always 5 / 0.3 and never influence retrieval. They are pure dead scaffolding — the retrieval-side knobs (max_facts_per_hop / similarity_threshold) actually live on the ripple assembler's own config, not here. Deleting the two fields (leaving a one-field struct or a const) removes an inert knob. max_output_chars is read but also never configured non-default; note it as a sibling observation in the same fix.

findings.title: Sub-agent 'Run id' prompt line is severed end-to-end: ResolvedContext.run_id is read by OperatingEnvelopeLayer but never written in production
findings.rationale: OperatingEnvelopeLayer renders '- Run id: `{id}`' from ResolvedContext.run_id (operating_envelope.rs:102-105), and the field is documented as 'sub-agent dispatch ONLY ... set by sub-agent dispatchers'. But no production code ever assigns ResolvedContext.run_id: grep for 'run_id' in harness_bridge/prompt_build.rs returns nothing, and the only Some(...) assignment in the tree is a unit test (operating_envelope.rs:394). The twin producer field TurnEnvelope.run_id (context.rs:183) is likewise always None — the sole TurnEnvelope construction site (run_loop/inner.rs:1362) hardcodes run_id: None, and prompt_build.rs bridges envelope.parent -> resolved_context.envelope_parent but has no corresponding envelope.run_id -> resolved_context.run_id bridge. Result: the feature looks implemented (two documented fields + a rendering layer + a test) but renders nothing in any production prompt. This is the exact '两端都在，连线断' shape. Reconnecting is real work (mint a run id in sub-agent dispatch, thread TurnEnvelope -> ResolvedContext); cutting removes a documented-but-dark feature. Product call, hence DECIDE rather than a silent CONNECT.

findings.title: TurnEnvelope::is_empty() omits the memory_mode field, violating its 'every field is None' contract
findings.rationale: is_empty() (context.rs:254) checks exec_tier, session_mode, cwd, serving_model, parent, run_id and response_language, but not memory_mode — the one remaining Option field on the struct (context.rs:207). A TurnEnvelope carrying only memory_mode: Some(Off) would report is_empty() == true even though it changes the prompt (memory is suppressed and OperatingEnvelopeLayer emits the 'Memory:' line via resolved_context.memory_muted, derived from injects_memory()). The doc comment explicitly promises 'True iff every field is None'. Today the method has no production caller (only context.rs tests exercise it), so impact is latent, but it is a landmine for the fast-path the doc advertises. Fix is one line (add && self.memory_mode.is_none()); alternatively delete the method if the fast-path never materializes.

findings.title: IdentityFile.truncated and original_size are write-only metadata never read by any layer or production consumer
findings.rationale: IdentityFile.truncated (line 69) and IdentityFile.original_size (line 71) are populated in IdentityFiles::load (identity_files.rs:136-165) and asserted in identity_files.rs's own unit tests, but no layer, serializer, or production path reads them. Grep for .truncated / original_size outside identity_files.rs finds only test fixtures constructing the struct and unrelated types (sandbox/tool outputs). No prompt layer surfaces a 'this file was truncated' notice to the model, and IdentityFile is not serialized (IdentityFileStatus is the separate UI type). The two fields are the module's own documented anti-pattern in reverse: data whose only reader is a unit test. CUT them (and their write-site bookkeeping) or, if a truncation notice is wanted, actually render one in IdentityFilesLayer.
